# **✍️ Quick notes**

## **Taha Mike \- PowerCloud OS Discussion**

Aug 21, 2026  
[Michael Flynn](mailto:mike@powerclouderp.com) [Taha Raja](mailto:taha@powerclouderp.com)

Meeting discussed operating system architecture, process improvements for artificial intelligence workflows, and upcoming all hands meeting planning.

## **PowerCloud OS Infrastructure**

* Michael confirmed the framework is fully built and available within the PowerCloud OS folders.  
* Michael and Taha discussed converting the PowerCloud OS project directory into a shared drive.  
* Current operation requires users to open Claude and browse directly to specific project folders.  
* There is no separate portal, so users must continue utilizing the standard terminal interface.

## **Executive Summary and Reporting**

* Michael is updating the executive summary to pull weekly hour logs from customer folders.  
* Executive summary data will be reliable weekly, effective every following Monday.  
* Automated humanization loops are integrated to refine output and remove fluffy language.  
* Custom development requires accompanying documentation including a use case and technical or functional document.

## **Governance and Approval Workflows**

* Taha proposed integrating an approval process where development teams verify AI-generated solutions.  
* Consultants will continue managing client communication and use case creation via Asana.  
* AI development will only proceed after verifying the client has approved the Asana request.  
* Michael emphasized treating Claude as a coworker, requiring explicit instructions to ensure accurate output.

## **All-Hands Meeting Planning**

* Michael scheduled a 90-minute all-hands meeting for September 3rd to roll out PowerCloud OS.  
* The session agenda focuses on end-to-end engagement workflows and team case study presentations.  
* Presenters must demonstrate specific, concrete examples rather than discussing abstract conceptual ideas.

## **Hardware Research**

* Michael is researching desktop hardware to resolve performance bottlenecks impacting his current device.  
* Taha recommended CyberPowerPC for high-end, upgradable desktop configurations suitable for AI workflows.  
* Taha advised prioritizing NVME solid-state storage, high-end GPUs, and 64GB of memory.

## **Meeting Scheduling and Logistics**

* Taha and Michael discussed adjusting the timing of recurring afternoon calls to accommodate Taha's upcoming work trip to India.  
* The participants agreed to review potential schedule changes once Taha is settled in India.

## **Next steps**

- [ ] \[Michael Flynn\] Distribute How-To Guide: Distribute the how-to PDF document to the team and mandate that all members complete the initial step zero setup.

### **Summary**

Meeting discussed operating system architecture, process improvements for artificial intelligence workflows, and upcoming all hands meeting planning.

**Operating System Infrastructure Setup**  
Standardizing project folders ensures better organization for new initiatives. Consolidating the project repository into a standalone shared drive improves file path management.

**Enhanced AI Approval Workflows**  
Integrating Asana into development ensures manual verification of client approval before script deployment. Automated logging for executive summaries reduces manual consultant reporting requirements.

**Operational Planning and Upgrades**  
Scheduling the mandatory all hands meeting for September 3 confirms the rollout plan. Upgrading personal computer hardware addresses performance issues related to artificial intelligence tool loads.

### **Decisions**

## Aligned

* **PowerCloud OS shared drive creation** The team decided to establish PowerCloud OS as a dedicated shared drive to keep paths short and maintain an isolated structure.

* **Terminology update for documentation** The team renamed the internal "Proposal" documentation to "Presentation" to better reflect its function and avoid terminology confusion.

* **Pre-development approval workflow implementation** The team will implement an approval workflow where Claude requires client approval verified via Asana before initiating any development tasks.

* **All-hands meeting scheduling** The team scheduled the mandatory all-hands meeting, titled "PowerCloud roll out," for September 11th.

* **PowerCloud OS Framework Structure**: Michael Flynn and Taha Raja discussed the current architecture of the PowerCloud OS framework, noting that everything except client folders consists of instructions, skills, and framework elements stored in a set of folders ([00:00:07](#00:00:07)). Michael Flynn explained that while existing accounts and tests have folders within the PowerCloud projects shared drive, new projects should be initialized directly within these structured folders, which will soon link to the sales cycle ([00:01:35](#00:01:35)).

  ![][image1]

* **PowerCloud OS Shared Drive Migration**: Taha Raja suggested elevating PowerCloud OS to its own standalone shared drive and legacy-ing or archiving the old PowerCloud projects folder to keep file paths short and clean, to which Michael Flynn agreed ([00:02:58](#00:02:58)). Michael Flynn noted that this setup remains completely portable as long as it is moved or reshared appropriately ([00:05:05](#00:05:05)).

* **Interface and Terminal Workflow**: Michael Flynn explained that they personally still work inside the terminal, but standard instructions given to consultants involve opening Claude, browsing to the project folder, and toggling between co-work chats and code all in one place ([00:05:05](#00:05:05)) ([00:10:41](#00:10:41)). Taha Raja and Michael Flynn both noted that using the application version of Claude offers functional similarities to Visual Studio Code, allowing users to efficiently manage chats and code side by side ([00:05:57](#00:05:57)).

* **Executive Summary Hour Integration**: Michael Flynn detailed an update to the executive summary process where hourly data is automatically populated into a log inside each customer folder every Monday morning, removing the need for consultants to manually export data or access NetSuite ([00:06:42](#00:06:42)). Taha Raja noted that this change and its weekly update schedule must be clearly communicated during the upcoming all-hands meeting so consultants understand that hourly summaries will lag by a week ([00:07:42](#00:07:42)).

* **Claude Engagement and Learning Loop**: Michael Flynn described the built-in learning loop where Claude interviews users at the end of a session to determine if specific adjustments are customer-specific or NetSuite-specific universal learnings ([00:15:41](#00:15:41)). Furthermore, Michael Flynn highlighted that documents generated by Claude run through a humanization loop to remove garbage and fluffy language ([00:16:34](#00:16:34)).

  ![][image2]

* **Deliverables and Custom Development Documentation**: Michael Flynn stated that every recovery or implementation ships three primary files after the initial phase: an assessment, a presentation (previously referred to as a proposal), and an internal execution plan ([00:16:34](#00:16:34)). Additionally, Taha Raja and Michael Flynn discussed that net-new custom developments require two mandatory documents: a use case, and a functional/technical handover methodology document ([00:17:36](#00:17:36)).

  ![][image3]

* **Connected Tech Stack and Verification**: Michael Flynn noted that the connected tech stack includes NetSuite, Celigo, Shopify, QuickBooks Online, and Asana, with Shopify utilizing an adopted MCP skill set. Michael Flynn added that Claude verifies claims against NetSuite, prioritizes the customer's website and Oracle official documentation for web research, and avoids arbitrarily dropping information deemed unimportant ([00:18:25](#00:18:25)).

  ![][image4]

* **AI Capabilities and Data Management**: Taha Raja shared a recent success where Claude successfully analyzed a customer complaint about an incorrect fastener specification, verified it, and corrected associated categories across the customer service portal system ([00:19:47](#00:19:47)). Michael Flynn expressed that Claude has exceeded expectations in ingesting messy conversation and raw data and formatting it accurately into NetSuite ([00:20:48](#00:20:48)).

* **Execution Guardrails and Approval Workflows**: Taha Raja raised concerns regarding consultants bypassing standard development processes by deploying complex scripts directly, noting that AI models can occasionally make binary overcomplications or bad decisions without human gray-area context ([00:24:34](#00:24:34)) ([00:27:43](#00:27:43)). To mitigate this risk, Taha Raja and Michael Flynn agreed to integrate Asana and the development team into an approval workflow where Claude must verify client approval via Asana or email before any script development or deployment takes place ([00:25:46](#00:25:46)).

* **All-Hands Meeting Rollout Plan**: Michael Flynn proposed structuring the upcoming all-hands meeting by first requiring everyone to complete step-zero setup (with calendar support available from Michael Flynn), walking through an end-to-end engagement narrative, and having Imran, Justin, and Ron present concrete examples of professional services work executed without custom development ([00:35:50](#00:35:50)) ([00:38:59](#00:38:59)). Taha Raja suggested that Michael Flynn and Taha Raja vet these presentations beforehand to ensure relevance and keep them limited to about 10 minutes ([00:38:02](#00:38:02)).

* **All-Hands Scheduling and Attendance**: After reviewing out-of-office schedules and potential conflicts surrounding the Labor Day holiday, Michael Flynn and Taha Raja scheduled the mandatory 90-minute all-hands meeting for September 3rd in the afternoon owner's time slot ([00:41:59](#00:41:59)) ([00:45:42](#00:45:42)). Taha Raja noted that they plan to join via Starlink on Qatar Airways while in flight if necessary ([00:44:51](#00:44:51)).

* **Hardware and Desktop Upgrade Consultation**: Due to local machine memory paging issues and heavy performance loads while running Claude and other tools, Michael Flynn discussed purchasing a new upgradable desktop computer with Taha Raja ([00:46:28](#00:46:28)) ([00:51:35](#00:51:35)). Taha Raja recommended cyberpowerpc.com for pre-built and custom desktop configurations featuring high-end solid-state NVME drives, sufficient RAM (such as 32 or 64 gigabytes), and robust video cards, noting that Michael Flynn could even ask Claude to help design an optimized PC build ([00:48:03](#00:48:03)) ([00:50:42](#00:50:42)).

  ![][image5]

* **Calendar Scheduling and Guide Distribution**: Taha Raja notes that the calendar meeting for September 3rd has already been organized. Michael Flynn commits to sending out the how-to guide to everyone, as well as specific instructions to Justin and Imran ([00:57:45](#00:57:45)).

* **Meeting Schedule Adjustments for Next Week**: Taha Raja discusses their upcoming travel plans, stating they will be available on Monday and reachable via voice on Tuesday evening during their flight before heading to India. Michael Flynn notes they cannot join on Tuesday and Wednesday, but both participants express openness to shifting afternoon calls earlier once Taha Raja settles in and can participate in late-morning sessions from their hotel room ([00:57:45](#00:57:45)).
